mechanics.claim: Jayce cannot cast To the Skies!/Shock Blast for 0.4 seconds after Thundering Blow's cast time completes.
mechanics.quote: '''Jayce''' is unable to cast {{ai|To the Skies!|Jayce}} or {{ai|Shock Blast|Jayce}} for {{fd|0.4}} seconds after Thundering Blow's cast time.

mechanics.claim: Jayce roots the target over the cast time before the damage/knockback is applied at the end of the cast.
mechanics.quote: '''Jayce''' {{tip|root|roots}} the target enemy over the cast time, then swings his hammer at them to deal {{as|magic damage}}
